purpose: Requirements for the agenda display layer that generates a human-readable presentation from the agenda record, giving an overview, change visibility and consistency with the record.
summary: Overview: display is separated from storage so presentation is generated from the record
Scope: presentation generated from records, overview, change highlighting, consistency with the record
Out of scope: storage and state management, presentation timing, presentation manners, content correctness
FNC-001: whole items, states and remaining count visible at a glance; withdrawn items remain shown
FNC-002: changes from the latest update are distinguishable in the presentation
FNC-003: presentation is generated from the record and AI never writes it directly
FNC-004: AI does not need to read the human-facing presentation to learn state
FNC-005: a specified item identifier can be reached directly
NFR-001: the presentation is recognizable as generated output
TBD-001 resolved: HTML is adopted as the format
tasks: Integrating the display with the agenda record
title: REQ-021 agenda 表示層 要件定義書
